intro.subtitle: ABOUT ADNGUARD
intro.desc1: In recent years, numerous food frauds have been revealed: mislabeled meats, species substitution, and deception about product composition. ADNGUARD was created to protect consumers and restore trust in food.
intro.desc2: Through independent DNA analysis, ADNGUARD accurately identifies animal species present in meat, even after cooking or processing. With ADNGUARD, you have reliable scientific proof of what you are consuming. Because food transparency should leave no room for doubt. ADNGUARD – Scientific proof for your trust.

about.heroTitle: The Largest DNA Testing Service Network
about.heroDesc: In response to recent scams — where butchers sold wild boar meat falsely labeled as halal, and restaurant owners served kebabs containing pork or cat meat — ADNGUARD was created to protect consumers and restore trust in the food chain.
about.missionDesc1: Guarantee total transparency and provide objective scientific proof where trust alone is no longer enough.
about.missionPoint1: Expose all fraud related to the origin of meat.
about.missionPoint2: Ensure the absence of pigs, wild boars, cats, and dogs.
about.missionPoint3: Provide independent and reliable scientific evidence.
about.missionDesc2: We remind everyone that, even if halal-certified restaurants and butchers may be involved, anything is possible in the absence of reliable control.
about.whoAreWeDesc: We remind everyone that, even if halal-certified restaurants and butchers may be involved, anything is possible in the absence of reliable control. That says why ADNGUARD offers a DNA testing service capable of identifying animal species present in meat, even after cooking or processing.
about.networkDesc: ADNGUARD offers a DNA testing service capable of identifying animal species present in meat, even after cooking or processing, providing a scientific, independent, and reliable answer.

process.title: How does ADNGUARD control work?
process.subtitle: A rigorous and transparent process to guarantee the authenticity of your products.

step1.title: Establishment Commitment
step1.desc: The professional voluntarily chooses to be controlled by ADNGUARD in a logic of transparency.

step2.title: Unannounced Controls
step2.desc: ADNGUARD performs surprise visits and takes samples on-site, without warning, to reflect the reality of products sold.

step3.title: Reliable DNA Analyses
step3.desc: Samples are analyzed by independent laboratories to identify animal species actually present, even after cooking or processing.

step4.title: Clear and Confidential Results
step4.desc: Results are recorded in a precise report, ensuring serious and responsible monitoring.

step5.title: ADNGUARD Accreditation
step5.desc: When controls are compliant, the establishment receives an ADNGUARD accreditation, visible to inform and reassure consumers.

transparency.title: Unannounced
transparency.desc: Our controls are performed without warning to ensure authentic results.

scientific.title: Scientific Proof
scientific.desc: DNA analysis is the only irrefutable proof of a product's composition.

independent.title: Independence
independent.desc: ADNGUARD is totally independent from the controlled establishments.
